humilie.part_desavouee: Unassailable dignity: self-affirmation that does not apologize, pride that does not depend on any gaze
micro_pas: 3 min of body presence: belly breath, relaxed shoulders, soft face
3 min of presence in the body: breath in the belly, relaxed shoulders, relaxed face
One pleasure action per day, without justification: "I give myself the right not to be able to take everything on".
humilie.morphologie: Rounded body, short stature, thick bulging neck; big round eyes, wide open, a child's innocence; honeyed voice.
humilie.origine: Between 1 and 3 years — the control and shame of the parent who represses pleasure (often the mother): cleanliness, the body, stifled freedom.

invisible.croyance: “My emotions don’t matter. I don't exist. ”
invisible.part_desavouee: Free existence: being there without producing, without pleasing, without proving — and saying it
micro_pas: 3 min of presence: hand on the heart, without bringing or proving anything
3 min of presence: hand on your heart, without bringing or proving anything
Three times a day: "what am I feeling, right here, right now?" — and name it, even in a whisper.
invisible.morphologie: Narrow, contracted body, as if it wanted to disappear; small tired eyes, evasive gaze; faint voice; dark clothes.
invisible.origine: From conception to 1 year — rejection by the parent of the same sex: feeling no right to exist.

abandonne.croyance: “I’m not enough for us to stay”
abandonne.part_desavouee: The presence that remains: the declared commitment, the loyalty that survives conflict, the door that does not slam
micro_pas: 3 min of presence: feet on the ground, “I am here, I stay”
3 min of presence: feet on the ground, "I'm here, I'm staying"
Ten compliments a day, to yourself and to others — filling the lack in a way other than clinging.
vocabulaire: no one lets go of me
abandonne.morphologie: Long, thin body, no muscle tone, slumping; drooping shoulders, hunched back; big sad eyes; small, plaintive child's voice.
abandonne.origine: Between 1 and 3 years — the lack of emotional nourishment with the parent of the opposite sex.

terrifie.croyance: “The world is not safe. I'm going to die. ”
terrifie.part_desavouee: Security incarnate: the calm that does not flee, the confidence that approaches, the quiet audacity
micro_pas: 3 min of presence: slow body scan, head to toe, without judging
3 min of presence: slow body scan, from head to toe, without judging
When fear rises: real fear or unreal fear? "What's the worst thing that could happen to me — and could I handle it?"
terrifie.morphologie: Upper body that shows off strength: shoulders wider than hips, puffed-out chest and belly; intense, seductive gaze; strong voice that carries far.
terrifie.origine: Fear is learned: between 0 and 7 years old, through overprotection or violence. The body learned that the world wasn't safe — separation anxiety, agoraphobia, any change lived as a symbolic death.

coupable.lieu_corporel: Weight on the shoulders, chest tightness
coupable.part_desavouee: Innocence granted: the fault named, repaired, filed — without condemnation or denial
micro_pas: 3 min of presence: long breath, “I have nothing to fix right now”
3 min of presence: long breath, "I have nothing to fix right now"
Spot one self-accusation of the day and reframe it as a fact: "I did what I could with what I knew".
coupable.morphologie: Straight, rigid body, as perfect as possible, well proportioned; clenched jaw, stiff neck; dry, fast voice.
coupable.origine: Between 4 and 6 years — the coldness and demandingness of the parent of the same sex: having to be perfect and right to be loved.

parentifie.blessure: Responsibility imposed too early, childhood stolen
parentifie.croyance: I have to save, I have no right to be a child
parentifie.lieu_corporel: Weight on the shoulders, chest tightness
parentifie.part_desavouee: Assumed vulnerability: receiving without calculating, letting yourself be carried away, being weak without danger
micro_pas: 3 min of presence: feel your own weight, without carrying anyone
3 min of presence: feel your own weight, without carrying anyone
Say no to a non-vital request, to check that the other survives without you.
vocabulaire: you can't make it without me
parentifie.morphologie: The body that carries: loaded shoulders, solid back, tense neck — the posture of the one who holds everything, and who collapses when they can't hold on anymore.
parentifie.origine: Very early — the child learns that their love is earned by forgetting themselves for others; they become the parent of their parents (the "savior" who carries their loved ones' happiness).

critique.strategie: Attack (self or other) before being attacked
critique.nouveau_role: Quality advisor: suggests after, never before momentum
critique.strategie_opposee: Carefree: “that’s enough,” doesn’t judge or judge himself, accepts error as given
critique.peur: If I don't attack, the Exile will be activated
micro_pas: One positive remark a day, said before any criticism

dependant_affectif.nouveau_role: Autonomous lover: autonomy in the bond
dependant_affectif.peur: The other one will leave if I don't hold on
micro_pas: One sentence of autonomy a day: “I had a good time on my own”
Wait 1 h before texting again — and say it: “I breathe, I don't chase”

intellectualiseur.strategie: Understand so as not to feel
intellectualiseur.strategie_opposee: Volcanic: feels everything, says everything, overflows, cries, screams
intellectualiseur.peur: If I don't understand, I'm not in control

One raw feeling a day, with no explanation: “I feel…” and nothing after
Name ONE emotion with its bodily location before analyzing
One raw feeling per day, without explanation: "I feel…" and nothing after
One emotion named before the analysis: "I feel…" before "I think that…".

Say one personal preference per day, even a trivial one
One sentence that won't please, said matter-of-factly, once a week

saboteur.nouveau_role: Guardian of reality: tests risks with lucidity
saboteur.strategie_opposee: The Confident: dares, fails, gets back up without destroying himself

Protect ONE thing under construction today instead of destroying one

perfectionniste.strategie: Never fail, never deliver anything imperfect
perfectionniste.nouveau_role: Guardian of the treatment: ensures the gentleness of the process

Deliver a "good enough" version on a fixed date, every week
One mistake named out loud without punishment: "I messed up, it happens"
In the evening: "did I do my best today?" instead of "was I perfect?"

ermite.nouveau_role: Privacy Sentry: Protects the safe circle without disappearing
ermite.strategie_opposee: Social invader: bonds in one evening, confides quickly, enters without knocking
ermite.peur: If I'm vulnerable, I'll be hurt

One short, defined presence a week: “I'll come for 30 min, then I leave”
Announce your distance with a return date: "I need 24 hours, I'll be back"
One short, defined presence per week: "I'll come for 30 min, then I'll leave"
Take your place once a day: voice your opinion or your presence, however small.

arrogant.nouveau_role: Bearer of dignity: stands upright without crushing
arrogant.strategie_opposee: Self-deprecating: belittles himself, refuses compliments, lies down to avoid the blow
micro_pas: One sincere acknowledgment of another a day, with no competition
Ask for help — even small — and receive it without paying it back

clown.strategie: Make people laugh to be kept
clown.nouveau_role: Animator of joy: lightness in the service of connection, without a mask
clown.strategie_opposee: Serious: serious, profound, does not laugh at himself, takes everything at face value
micro_pas: One true sentence said WITHOUT turning it into a joke, once a day
Be serious for 5 min a day, no clowning

victime.strategie: To be pitied to be seen
victime.strategie_opposee: Assumed executioner ⚠️ (see safeguards — often LURE, not mirror)
micro_pas: One direct request a day: “I need…” without turning it into a complaint
Name ONE personal strength each morning, without downplaying it
One direct request per day: "I need…" without turning it into a complaint
Name ONE personal strength every morning, without downplaying it
One complaint turned into a request: name what I need instead of "poor me".

gardien_image.nouveau_role: Presence passer: lets you see the human behind the mask
gardien_image.strategie_opposee: Hyper-honest: tells the raw truth, including the ugly one, without filter or makeup

Share a real emotion before telling a success story
One imperfection shown voluntarily per day: "there, I can't do it"
Share a real emotion before telling about a success
Once a day: a truth told without embellishment — to check that I survive without the perfect mask.

sauveur.strategie: Give to exist, never say no

sauveur.strategie_opposee: Assumed recipient: asks, takes, does not systematically give back, lives without apologizing for his needs

Receive help without giving back: “thank you” and nothing else
Say NO to a request, even a small one, today
Receive help without giving back: "thank you" and nothing else

comparateur.nouveau_role: Progress indicator: compare to yourself yesterday

comparateur.peur: Being less than others — the humiliation of being surpassed

reveur.strategie: Dreaming instead of acting, waiting for the big night
reveur.nouveau_role: Architect of possibilities: dream AND plan
reveur.strategie_opposee: The Pragmatic: lives in reality, actions before dreams

One “I start” before the “what if…”: write the first concrete step

One decision in under 5 min a day, without weighing everything

seducteur.strategie: Seduce to prove one's worth — desire as proof of existence

seducteur.nouveau_role: Passer of presence: intimate without proving
seducteur.peur: If I don't please, I don't exist

Before every flirt: “do I want, or am I proving?”

heros.strategie: Brushing up against danger to feel alive
heros.nouveau_role: Guard courage: dare to be vulnerable
heros.strategie_opposee: The Prudent: slow, safe, prefers comfort
heros.peur: Being seen as weak or cowardly
micro_pas: Tell your fear to a safe person, once a week
One gentle, risk-free action, chosen for pleasure and not for proof

thesauriseur.strategie: Money as absolute security, anxiety about spending

thesauriseur.nouveau_role: Link treasurer: security through links, not money

Name one non-material resource: a bond, a skill, a roof

provocateur.strategie: Provoke, test, push to the limit to see if we stay
provocateur.nouveau_role: Link Questioner: Ask instead of test
provocateur.strategie_opposee: The Welcoming: believes the love that gives itself

One week with no tests, welcoming love as it comes

jaloux.strategie: Watch so as not to be left
jaloux.nouveau_role: Guardian of the Link: Homeland Security
jaloux.strategie_opposee: The Free: lives his life, does not monitor
jaloux.peur: The other will leave if I don't control

10 min without checking, then a direct request for reassurance

hypervigilant.strategie: Scan the signs of rejection, reread each interaction

5 min of orienting a day: look into the distance, name 5 real objects

evitant.strategie: Avoid conflict, accumulate what remains unsaid

evitant.strategie_opposee: The Confrontant: goes towards conflict, emptiness on the spot

rancunier.nouveau_role: Guardian of memory: justice without hatred

One grace granted a week: “here, I drop the bill”

accusateur.peur: If it's not his fault, it's mine

One sentence of responsibility without blame: “I feel…, I need…”

survivant.strategie_opposee: L'Oisif: produces nothing and is doing well

Say out loud “I'm done for today”, at a fixed time

planificateur.strategie_opposee: Spontaneous: nothing is planned, everything is possible
micro_pas: One unplanned moment a day: 10 min of pure improvisation
Allow ONE change of plan without fixing it

froid.nouveau_role: Container: healthy distance that does not freeze
froid.strategie_opposee: Tactile: hugs, sweet words, need for contact

Name one emotion to a safe person, once a week

ascete.nouveau_role: Joyful sobriety: pleasure without excess or shame
ascete.strategie_opposee: The Unbridled: lives the body, pleasure without shame

When deprivation hardens: “what am I forbidding myself, and why?”

muet.nouveau_role: Diplomat of saying: said coldly, on time
muet.strategie_opposee: The Crier: says everything, right away, even what is annoying

Replace “everything is fine” with a true sentence: “things aren't great right now”

auto_devalorise.strategie: Demeaning yourself, refusing compliments, lying down to avoid the blow
auto_devalorise.nouveau_role: Proud humility: stands tall without crushing
auto_devalorise.strategie_opposee: Unassailable Dignity: asserts itself without apologizing
micro_pas: Receive a compliment without refusing it: “thank you” and nothing else
One fair sentence about yourself a day, without crushing it: “I did my best”

dormeur.strategie: Sleep so as not to feel the lack
dormeur.nouveau_role: Lively rhythm: gentle structure and regular awakenings
micro_pas: Wake up at a fixed time, even on free days
10 min of awake presence before falling back asleep: name what is here
